summary: Frontend-only testing of mobile hamburger menu on ACID site. All 6 requested test scenarios PASS. Mobile (375x812): burger visible (display:flex), overlay hidden initially, opens on tap (visibility:visible, burger.open class true), contains exactly 5 links in correct order + 2 lang buttons. Clicking Servicios & El método each update location.hash and auto-close menu (visibility:hidden). EN/ES toggle inside menu switches hero copy (ES: 'Cine que vende.' <-> EN: 'Film that sells.'). Desktop (1440x800): burger display:none, 5 inline nav links visible, hash updates on click. Regression: /, /aviso-de-privacidad, /aviso-legal return 200. Chat FAB opens chat panel. No blocking JS errors (only static 404s for asset files, do not break rendering).

issues: Console shows repeated 404s for static assets (non-blocking, but should be cleaned up by main agent)

action_items: Optional: investigate 404s in console for missing static assets
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile menu uses opacity/visibility transition (not display) - correct approach for animatability. Body scroll lock via useEffect on menuOpen is proper. z-index:400 correctly covers chat FAB when menu open (intended).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile hamburger menu fully working. Uses data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle' and 'mobile-menu'. Overlay toggled via .open class on .nav-links (visibility+opacity). Each link auto-closes menu via setMenuOpen(false) onClick. Language toggle keeps menu open (by design).
